risks.risk: The wall bracket may be loose or the power cord may be damaged.

proof_requests: Video of the unit powered on and the indicator light working.
Photo of the interior of the dryer with the top cover removed.
Photo of the wall bracket and the power cord.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
